name: Carved Mourner OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
description: The carving weeps. Its tears turn to a mist that covers the halls.
disable: DC 17 Religion (trained) to recite prayers for the dead, or dwarven-lore|dc:14 to speak the history of Raseri Kanton, or DC 20 Thievery to plug the holes in the carving

generalAbilities.name: Weep for Raseri Kanton
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature looks at the carved mourner

Effect The hallways fill with a thick mist. When the mist first appears, all living creatures in area A take 1d6 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save), and all undead creatures regain 1d6 Healing Damage Hit Points. All creatures within the mist become Concealed. This mist lasts for 1 hour or until the haunt is disabled.
